articleTitle: Hootsuite Homepage Teardown: Jan 2023 to Jun 2026
h1: How Hootsuite rewrote its homepage over 3 years

messaging.before: Grow your reach and get more business with social media. Let's do this.
messaging.after: Drive real business impact with the world’s deepest social intelligence and management platform
messaging.note: The shift from casual outcome language to formal capability framing can be read as a move toward upmarket positioning. This is observation, not confirmed strategy.

messaging.before: Save time and grow on social with Hootsuite, your all-in-one social media scheduler, manager, and analytics secret weapon. Give it a try for free!
messaging.after: Hootsuite is a social media management tool that brings scheduling, content creation, analytics, and social listening to one place.
messaging.note: Free-trial urgency and exclamatory language removed. The new description reads as a neutral product category statement — more consistent with a platform positioning than a trial-conversion tool.

messaging.before: Social Media Marketing and Management Tool - Hootsuite
messaging.after: Social Media Marketing and Management Tool | Hootsuite
